* update package lock

* 🎨 UI updates

* feat: implement verse highlight following on remote scripture navigation

- Add activeScripture store subscription to send ACTIVE_SCRIPTURE messages to remote
- Include scriptureId in activeScripture store to identify correct scripture tab
- Add currentScriptureState store in remote to track scripture position from main app
- Add ACTIVE_SCRIPTURE receiver handler to update remote scripture state
- Update ScriptureContent to react to scripture state changes and update verse highlighting
- Fix type comparison issue by using loose equality for verse highlighting (number vs string)
- Support both API and local bible formats for chapter ID handling

Resolves issue where verse highlight would not follow when using next/previous buttons on remote show control.

* Add always-visible go back button to scripture navigation header

- Add go back button to scripture header for consistent navigation
- Button positioned on left with centered scripture title
- Always visible when viewing scripture, styled appropriately for depth
- At depth 0: dark styling, allows switching translations
- At depth > 0: normal styling, navigates back one level
- Improved UX with proper centering and layering

* Implement advanced scripture search functionality for remote interface

- Add comprehensive search capabilities matching frontend features
- Support book abbreviations (jh -> john, mt -> matthew, etc.)
- Handle multiple reference formats (colon, comma, period separators)
- Include verse content search with highlighting
- Navigate to specific verse depth when clicking search results
- Proper search clearing and result management
- Support chapter-only searches showing all verses
- Limit results display to 20 with overflow indicator
- White reference text and proper text wrapping for long search terms

* minor changed

* Revert changes from commit 3f1a520 - Remove always-visible go back button from scripture navigation header

* Revert

* remote: Scripture header and UX improvements
- Unified header with fixed back/search actions
- Added second-line reference (Book Chapter[:Verse])
- Prevented header shift and overflow; responsive title sizing
- Search view now has back button and keeps state stable
- Global scrollbar styling for RemoteShow to match main app
- A11y and typing cleanups; removed unused styles

* remote: Shows.svelte: native scrollbar on desktop; always-visible custom scrollbar on mobile; fixed track bounds and scrolling behavior

* fix up title bar

* Remote: scripture header size/centering, no-ellipsis wrap; larger touch targets for back/search; persist TabletMode left/right panel widths per browser via localStorage

* Removed accessibility errors from console and updated login UI

* cleaning up code and comments

* fix ui scrollbar in projects

* login should now be per device, updated login ui

* fix up highlighting, toggle list button, intial load

* fixing highlighting and verse bouncing

* code improvements

* Revert delay back

* added API bible support, new highlight

* highlight on reload

* Apply consistent FreeShow UI scrollbar styling to all remote components

- Added FreeShow scrollbar styling to Textarea component (fixes song editing scrollbar)
- Applied consistent scrollbar styling to Lyrics.svelte scroll area
- Added scrollbar styling to Show.svelte scroll container
- Updated AddGroups.svelte groups list with FreeShow scrollbars
- Applied scrollbar styling to GroupsEdit.svelte groups container
- Added FreeShow scrollbars to Project.svelte scroll and list areas
- Updated PdfPreview.svelte grid with consistent scrollbar styling

All scrollable areas in the remote frontend now use the unified FreeShow UI scrollbar design instead of native browser scrollbars.

* final cleanup and commit, improved search parsing

* 🔊 Audio start/end trim
- Conditions works for metadata templates
- Fixed scripture verse order sometimes broken
- Small tweaks
- Version update

* Fix verse 1 duplication when split by 'Split long verses' feature (#2657)

When clicking a book name to auto-focus on verse 1, then shift-clicking
to extend the selection, verse 1 would appear twice if it was split into
multiple parts (1_1, 1_2, etc).

The issue occurred because:
- Initial selection defaulted to plain [1]
- Split verses feature created [1_1, 1_2] instead
- Range selection added both plain '1' and split '1_1', '1_2'

Fix: After range selection, filter out plain verse IDs when their split
versions exist in the selection.

* Show Style custom First slide template in preview

* Colored grid mode

* Fixed PDF landscape export #3342

* Fix: resolve controlshow bug where current slide in draw mode isn't updated when slides are updated using the controller (#3344)

* Enhanced some tips

* fix(spotify): repair Linux MPRIS controls, seek and progress bar (#3357)

On Linux all Spotify controller commands go through dbus-send, which had
three issues:

- Controls (play/pause, next, prev) were sent without --type=method_call,
  so dbus-send defaulted to "signal" and the player ignored them.
- Seek used the invalid dbus-send type "x64:" instead of "int64:".
- Position was parsed with /uint64/, which matched mpris:length (duration)
  instead of the int64 Position property, pinning the progress bar at 100%.

Tested on Ubuntu 26.04 and 25.10 (GNOME/Wayland, native Spotify client).

* fix(sync): merge SYNCED_SETTINGS collections per-item via the created/deleted ledger (#3354)

* Fix chord layout autosizing (#3352)

* Add stage layout import and export (#3353)

* Fix Windows output visibility during Aero Peek (#3360)

* Fixed BMD output not working

* Fixed frame sometimes not updating #3362

* Fixed audio paused state not always updating #3359

* Fixed Planning Center chords import #3348

* Fixed {slide_text_ item order
- Fixed slide_text not getting empty items

* Fixed errors

* Fixed errors

* Set custom fade out duration

* Fixed media not loading on zoom
- Column of 2 now loads the full media

* Fixed NDI audio being choppy

* test(sync): unit tests + pure SyncLedger module for per-item SYNCED_SETTINGS merge (#3335) (#3355)

* Version update
